tire_source.evidence: Organizer STL plus the reviewed mm-unit evidence in VERIFIED-FACTS.md; nominal bore is a design callout, not a clearance-certified manufactured minimum.

limitations: Coupons are for low-force geometry and alignment experiments only; they are not complete capture mechanisms or production CAD.
Gauge diameters are nominal STL dimensions. Measure printed parts and the actual tire; do not force a gauge or infer a production fit.
The fork coupon tests approach geometry only and has no retention, release, actuator, structural or competition-legality validation.
A printed tire surrogate does not reproduce official TPU mass, friction, compliance or surface finish.
Paper/SVG templates must be printed at 100%/actual size and rejected if the 50 mm calibration line is not 50 mm.
